title: Modelling daily activity patterns from mobile phone location data via deep representation learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Passively collected mobile phone location data provide large-scale, longitudinal observations of human mobility but do not directly reveal activity purposes. The functional characteristics of visited locations offer useful contextual information, yet their relationship with activity purpose remains uncertain, particularly in mixed-use urban environments. We conceptualise activity pattern mining as an integrated process of representation, clustering, and interpretation, and propose the Activity Chain Encoder (ACE) for the representation stage. ACE is a self-supervised model that combines pre-trained urban embeddings with visit timing and duration and uses a Transformer to model the sequential organisation of stays. It is trained using masked activity modelling and identity-guided contrastive learning without requiring deterministic activity purpose labels. translated_title: 基于深度表征学习从手机位置数据中建模日常活动模式
translated_abstract: 被动收集的手机位置数据为人类移动研究提供了大规模、长期纵向的观测，但无法直接揭示活动目的。所访问地点的功能特征提供了有用的上下文信息，但其与活动目的之间的关系仍不确定，尤其是在混合功能的城市环境中。我们将活动模式挖掘概念化为表征、聚类与解释的集成过程，并在表征阶段提出了活动链编码器（ACE）。ACE是一种自监督模型，它将预训练的城市嵌入与到访时间和停留时长相结合，并利用Transformer对停留序列的组织结构进行建模。该模型通过掩码活动建模和身份引导的对比学习进行训练，无需确定性的活动目的标签。学习到的日常活动表征被聚合为用户级画像，再进行聚类，（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自监督模型ACE（活动链编码器），将预训练城市嵌入与到访时间及停留时长结合，通过Transformer、掩码活动建模和身份引导对比学习，在无需活动目的标签的情况下从手机位置数据中学习日常活动模式表征。
en_tdlr: Proposes ACE, a self-supervised Transformer-based Activity Chain Encoder that combines pre-trained urban embeddings with visit timing and duration to learn daily activity pattern representations from mobile phone location data without requiring activity purpose labels.
